title: UW Issue Remediation Entry
description: One entry in a remediation registry. Renderers SHOULD surface the title and remediation text verbatim — the goal is uniform UX across every conforming implementation. Modules ship their own entries to extend BUILTIN_REMEDIATIONS. Mirrors the IssueRemediation interface in @uwmd/core/protocol.ts and is referenced by ProtocolError.code lookups. See UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §III.6.

code.description: Stable validation code (e.g. 'CC-01'). MUST match the code on a ValidationMessage / ProtocolError for the renderer to look it up.

severity.description: Default severity emitted by the validator. Implementations MAY override per institution config.

title.description: Short title shown in the issue list (e.g. 'Sources & Uses imbalance').

description.description: Plain-language description of what is wrong.

remediation.description: Imperative remediation copy (e.g. 'Recompute LTV = loan_amount / underwritten value and restate debt_structure.ltv.').

spec_ref.description: Spec section anchor for deep-linking (e.g. '§5.3 CC-01').

examples.title: Sources & Uses imbalance
examples.remediation: Reconcile the capital stack — equity + debt proceeds + other sources MUST equal price + closing + reserves.
